repo.name: OneUI Mods
repo.description: Signed releases of OneUI Mods apps for Samsung Galaxy. Includes experimental versions. See each app repository for device support and setup.

apps.description: Adds system, light and dark appearance options to supported versions of SESAME and povo. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework such as Vector. The supported host apps are proprietary; they are not bundled.
apps.name: Dark App Tools

apps.description: Adjusts clock text and status icons to the background on supported Galaxy firmware, with configurable fades, app transition tracking and privacy indicator motion. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. Android 16 and 17 support is firmware specific.
apps.name: Galaxy Adaptive Bar
apps.summary: Adapt status bar colors to the background

apps.description: Optional camera preview, lens transition and camera capability adjustments for supported Samsung Camera, Camera Assistant and Expert RAW versions. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. Hardware and firmware limits still apply; unsupported modes are not guaranteed.
apps.name: Galaxy Camera Tools

apps.description: Adds optional recording rotation, app targeting, audio and capture controls to supported Samsung and Android recording components. Call playback can be included explicitly while preserving the selected app audio scope. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. Call capture availability depends on the audio route and app. Read the source README for supported firmware and activation steps.
apps.name: Galaxy Capture Tools

apps.description: User-initiated SystemUI reload helper for supported Galaxy devices. Requires root. Its unlock-state handling is only available when the device is already authenticated; it does not disable screen-lock credentials.
apps.name: Galaxy Reload
apps.summary: Reload SystemUI on supported Galaxy devices

apps.description: Reformats supported Samsung Service Mode screens for readability while retaining the original diagnostic data. Requires root and a libxposed API 102 compatible framework. This unofficial module does not bundle or replace the proprietary Samsung phone app.
apps.name: Galaxy Service Panel
apps.summary: Improve the Samsung Service Mode layout

apps.description: Changes the supported Galaxy camera shutter sound setting after its required permission has been granted. Use Galaxy Shutter Mute Manager for installation on recent Android versions. Samsung firmware and regional restrictions may limit availability.
apps.name: Galaxy Shutter Mute
apps.summary: Control the supported Galaxy shutter sound setting

apps.description: Installs and grants the settings permission needed by Galaxy Shutter Mute through Shizuku. The companion app is downloaded only after the user's explicit action. Galaxy Shutter Mute remains a separate app. Support depends on Samsung firmware, region and camera version.
apps.name: Galaxy Shutter Mute Manager
apps.summary: Set up Galaxy Shutter Mute through Shizuku

apps.description: Disables supported Samsung OS update services and restores their previous state. Requires root. Google Play system and application updates are outside its scope. Restore the original state before uninstalling or clearing this app's data.
apps.name: Galaxy Update Guard
apps.summary: Pause and restore Galaxy OS updates

apps.description: Stream selected-app media or device playback and notification sounds to HomePod over AirPlay 2. Requires root and a compatible Xposed framework such as Vector enabled for System UI. Microphone and call audio are excluded. Includes adjustable latency and buffer controls. HomePod and its proprietary receiver firmware are not bundled. See the source README for supported devices and setup.
apps.name: HomePod Bridge

apps.description: Fixes a native Unity startup crash in the supported arm64 editions of the D4DJ D4U and Sekai trials. Requires root and an API 102 compatible Xposed framework. Does not bundle games or restore discontinued online services. See the source README for the exact supported versions.
apps.name: Legacy Game Tools
apps.summary: Startup compatibility for supported older game trials

apps.description: Adjust supported One UI Home folder behavior, quick panel controls and developer animation settings. Requires root, a libxposed API 102 compatible framework and supported Samsung system components. Keep the source README at hand for supported firmware and reload instructions.
apps.name: One UI Home Tweaks
apps.summary: Customize One UI Home and the quick panel

apps.description: Browse OneUI Mods apps, compare installed versions with public GitHub releases, choose whether to include experimental releases, and download verified updates. Installation always uses the Android confirmation screen. GitHub downloads are user initiated and bypass the official F-Droid build review.
apps.name: OneUI Mods Manager
apps.summary: Manage and update apps from OneUI Mods

apps.description: Manage supported dual-SIM data switching through Shizuku or Shizuku Plus. Requires compatible device telephony services and explicit Shizuku permission. No root is needed when Shizuku is available through wireless debugging.
apps.name: SIM Pilot

apps.description: Helps supported app-store components include deep-sleeping apps in their update listings. Requires root, a compatible Xposed framework and supported store versions. It does not bundle the store apps.
apps.name: SleepStore

apps.description: Provides an authorized ADB transport restricted to the device's Tailscale interface, with per-peer shell and root permissions and network recovery. Requires root and the separate Tailscale app. It uses the selected Tailscale account's network; no Tailscale code is bundled.
apps.name: Tail ADB
apps.summary: ADB access over your Tailscale network
